bio.text: Aaron Pilkington, a Republican, has represented District 45 in the Arkansas House of Representatives since January 2023 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

He graduated from Fairmont Senior High School in 2009, earned a bachelor's degree in business administration and management from Washington & Jefferson College in 2013, and earned a master's degree in healthcare administration from the University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences in 2015.

His career experience includes working as vice president of strategic communications with ARcare, as a network development specialist with the Arkansas Health Network, and as director of care management at Access Medical Clinics.
